description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Warwick''' gains [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] '''bonus''' attack speed for 1.25 seconds upon damaging a target to or while they are below [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] 50% of their '''maximum''' health with a basic attack or [[File:Lay Waste.png|20px|link=Ability damage|An icon representing the keyword Ability damage]] [[:Ability damage|ability damage]], refreshing with subsequent damaging basic attacks or ability damage to enemies below the threshold. If '''Warwick''' does not have the '''bonus''' attack speed already, he also gains it upon initiating an [[:Attack speed#Windup|attack windup]] against an enemy below the threshold.
description.text: Passive: Warwick gains  bonus attack speed for 1.25 seconds upon damaging a target to or while they are below  50% of their maximum health with a basic attack or ability damage, refreshing with subsequent damaging basic attacks or ability damage to enemies below the threshold. If Warwick does not have the bonus attack speed already, he also gains it upon initiating an attack windup against an enemy below the threshold.

description2.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Warwick''' senses all enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] on the map who are damaged below [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] 50% of their '''maximum''' health by him or an allied source, marking them with ''Blood Hunt'' until they [[File:Health regeneration icon.svg|15px|link=Health regeneration]] regenerate or [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|heal]] above this threshold again. He sees trails leading toward them and gains [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] '''bonus''' movement speed while following a trail. This bonus is lost for 0.5 seconds upon [[Combat status|entering champion combat]], but will build up again over 3.5 seconds.
description2.text: Passive: Warwick senses all enemy champions on the map who are damaged below  50% of their maximum health by him or an allied source, marking them with Blood Hunt until they  regenerate or heal above this threshold again. He sees trails leading toward them and gains  bonus movement speed while following a trail. This bonus is lost for 0.5 seconds upon entering champion combat, but will build up again over 3.5 seconds.

description3.raw: The attack speed and movement speed bonuses granted by both passives are doubled against enemies who are below [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] 25% of their '''maximum''' health.
description3.text: The attack speed and movement speed bonuses granted by both passives are doubled against enemies who are below  25% of their maximum health.

description4.raw: '''Active:''' '''Warwick''' senses the nearest enemy champion in the area at the start of the cast time, marking them with ''Blood Hunt'' for 8 seconds, gaining both passive bonuses against them regardless of their [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] '''current''' health.
description4.text: Active: Warwick senses the nearest enemy champion in the area at the start of the cast time, marking them with Blood Hunt for 8 seconds, gaining both passive bonuses against them regardless of their  current health.

description5.raw: ''Blood Hunt's'' [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown is reduced by 30% if no enemy champions are found within range.
description5.text: Blood Hunt's  cooldown is reduced by 30% if no enemy champions are found within range.

This includes '''Warwick''' himself, champions, [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]], and [[File:Turret icon.png|20px|link=Turret|An icon representing the keyword Turret]] [[:Turret|turrets]]. ** The only exception is the allied [[File:Nexus Obelisk.png|20px|link=Nexus Obelisk|An icon representing the keyword Nexus Obelisk]] [[:Nexus Obelisk|Nexus Obelisk]], because that deals [[File:Fear Beyond Death 2.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Raw damage]] [[:Damage|internalraw]] damage, which does not trigger damage-related events such as ''Blood Hunt's'' marking. * Note that [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]] are neutral units. * ''Blood Hunt'' can detect and target [[Champion_summoned_units#decoys|decoys]]. * ''Blood Hunt'' will occur from wherever '''Warwick''' was at the start of the cast time. * ''Blood Hunt'' has an indicator that appears above the target(s) when they are being hunted. Some skins have a unique indicator. notes.text:
The initiation of the attack windup to gain the bonus attack speed is only for gaining the bonus; it does not refresh the duration of the attack speed buff if Warwick has it already.
Blood Hunt is a form of obscured vision.
If Blood Hunt was cast with no enemy champions within range, the ability incurs its cast time then goes on cooldown without marking any target.
As mentioned by the description, Blood Hunt only marks enemy champions if they are damaged below the thresholds by an allied source. This includes Warwick himself, champions, minions, and turrets.
* The only exception is the allied Nexus Obelisk, because that deals internalraw damage, which does not trigger damage-related events such as Blood Hunt's marking.
Note that monsters are neutral units.
Blood Hunt can detect and target decoys.
Blood Hunt will occur from wherever Warwick was at the start of the cast time.
Blood Hunt has an indicator that appears above the target(s) when they are being hunted. Some skins have a unique indicator.
